$comment: The live configuration (Step 1.5b, design E): an overlay on seed.json, merged in memory by `omniroute_seed.py apply|verify --live` for the ephemeral omniroute-live instance (127.0.0.1:20131) only. It adds the host-native Ollama connection and points the self-hosted combos at it; gen-converse and gen-recommend stay on the stubs (O4, RD-1 deferred). One target per combo, no global fallback. The model (C5b, 2026-11-19) is Ollama's qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M, manifest sha256:d8b0f5e9760cd1682034f292d7ef72ec46f432149be0df7574bf2d6e92e38c04, on Ollama 0.40.16 (decision log §2, Qwen3.5 4B decisions), one model on all four routes. payloadRules turns thinking off (decision 7) and sets temperature 0 (decision 4) for that bare model name only: a prefixed name doesn't match (§3.13). It goes to PUT /api/settings/payload-rules; PATCH /api/settings drops it. HARDENING.md, "Live instance".
